diary_prompts.prompt: You sit at the edge of your bed. The city hums outside. What are you feeling right now?
The book chose Punjab for you. Why do you think it did?
The fields are passing by. Meher asked you to really look. What do you see?
A family you have never met welcomed you like their own. What does that make you feel?

notes.skip_behavior: Diary icon is non-intrusive and optional. Skipping reduces emotional depth of final AI log but never blocks gameplay.
notes.ai_generation_rule: Minimum 1 entry required for AI log generation. If zero entries exist, fallback to static reflection.
